import java.util.Scanner;

public class A_391_Variant3 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = sc.nextLine();
        int result = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); ) {
            char current = input.charAt(i);
            int length = 0;
            
            // Count the length of the current run of identical characters
            while (i < input.length() && input.charAt(i) == current) {
                length++;
                i++;
            }
            
            // If the run length is even, we need to insert one character to make it odd
            if (length % 2 == 0) {
                result++;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
